notes.title: Bug Hunt 8/8-19
notes.content:
When You die as one of the cyborgs, You lose that cyborg.
And restart at the Mission Map. You keep your money and the skills.
If You die as Human... You die.

If You save the game, it will remember what level you are playing at.
(You could only get The "Complete Game on Medium/Hard", if You complete the game in one sitting.)

Now You can only get the "Master of The Pipe", if You have NO other weapons, when You complete the game.

Fixed the bug for Taking 5 snapshots for  Facebook.

notes.title: Bug Hunt 12/7-19
notes.content:
Updated Enemies Sounds.
Updated the Bee's Attack & Max Height. (Now they can Swarm attack.)

Faster Garbage collection for the RoadRunner.

When You Put down Garbage, it is packed in rows, making it easier to pick up again.

Change Camera angle on 3rd person Camera's.
Added a 3rd person Camera to the Truck.

notes.title: Update Garbage Shapes 2/7-19
notes.content:
Change the Garbage Shapes.
Now You can see what type of garbage it is, by the shape (and Color).

Added a Bug-report Button.

Upgraded 3-4 minion bugs.

notes.title: 60FPS & The Golden Gun
notes.content:
1. Now with 60 Fps. Change vSync, so it fresh faster.

2. If you Buy level 10 in Gun, Uzi or MiniGun, it is in Gold.
(And it is an Achievement..)

3. Added some Merchandise for my game..

notes.title: Update 25/9-18
notes.content:
Just a new build because something was wrong with the last version.

Added a God Mode.
When you have completed the game, you can start again with 1,000,000 gold.

Added screen scaling.
The players screen now is scaled to match the Canvas, and the letters also scale.

notes.title: The Crusher
notes.content:
Updated the distance between Player and Enemies, so you can kill the Enemies with the 3 first Guns.

The Mini-Gun Still needs some distance to work.

Change the Character you start with, to the Crusher, so you can try the strongest of the Cyborgs.

Added some background music, for the levels.
